$comment: Dex-written content for the TOS era (#641), merged over the mod's text by pipeline/dexpipe/content.py. "auto" fields are derived from the ship's own weapons, abilities and research.

description.summary:
The pride of the Terran Empire's fleet, a mirror-universe warship that answers to no one. It builds and launches ships of its own and is armed to rule by force.
In the Terran Empire a captain keeps command only as long as no one takes it, and none is fought over harder than this. She flies the Empire's colours ahead of its fleets, and the worlds she visits learn quickly what obedience means.
An automated work craft of the 2260s that repairs damaged starships and builds new stations and subsystems on the frontier.

The most famous Constitution-class starship of her day. As the fleet's flagship she builds and launches new ships, and her phasers and photon torpedoes make her a match for any single opponent.
Under Captain Kirk her five-year mission made her the most famous ship in the Federation. Wherever she flies, she carries the Federation's word: the ship sent first, and trusted most.

fed_TOS_flagship.source: Memory Alpha, USS Enterprise (NCC-1701): crew of 430.

description.summary: A Kepler-class outpost of the kind that watched the Neutral Zone. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor holds attackers at a distance.
A Starfleet mining bee of the 2260s, cutting dilithium from asteroids and carrying it back to a freighter or outpost for processing.
An Antares-class freighter fitted to process dilithium in the field. It carries and maintains its own flight of mining bees.
A light Starfleet construction facility for destroyers and light to medium cruisers, with one berth for repairs.
A large orbital starbase: a shipyard, resource depot and safe harbour in one, with a warp inhibitor to protect the space around it.

fed_TOS_starbase.source: Dimensions measured from the fed_TOS_starbase model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary: A work craft of the Imperial fleet that repairs battle damage and raises new stations and subsystems as the Empire expands.

Koloth's D7 battlecruiser, leading the Klingon fleet. It can cloak, and it builds and launches new warships from its own bays.
Captain Koloth's command, and the ship every Klingon captain on the frontier measures themselves against. She leads the Empire's push towards the Federation border, and where she goes, the fleet follows.

kng_TOS_flagship.source: Memory Alpha, IKS Gr'oth. Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 67, the D7 class.

description.summary: A Kan'Qul-class outpost, refitted for the Empire's expansion in the 2260s. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
An Imperial mining bee that strips dilithium from asteroids for the Empire's expanding fleets.
An Imperial shipyard of the 2260s, turning out destroyers and light to medium cruisers and repairing one ship at a time.
A work craft that repairs Romulan warbirds and builds new stations and subsystems behind the Neutral Zone.

The flagship of the Romulan fleet, a cloaked warbird armed with plasma torpedoes. It builds and launches new ships from its own bays.
She bears the name of a place on Romulus itself, and with it the Empire's pride. Her commander is the voice of the Senate beyond the Neutral Zone, and no warbird moves without her word.
A Jaltak-class outpost from behind the Neutral Zone. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor gives Romulan patrols time to respond.
A Romulan mining bee that gathers dilithium from the asteroid fields behind the Neutral Zone.
A Romulan mining freighter that refines dilithium close to the asteroid fields and keeps a flight of mining bees working around it.
A Romulan shipyard behind the Neutral Zone that builds destroyers and light to medium cruisers and repairs one ship at a time.
An ancient automated weapon that destroys planets and feeds on the rubble. Its neutronium hull shrugs off almost any attack, and its antiproton beam can gut a starship in moments.

zzz_TOS_planetkiller.source: Memory Alpha, Planet killer (TOS "The Doomsday Machine"). Dimensions measured from the zzz_TOS_planetkiller (converted from its DAE) model (pipeline/render/measure.py). Crew: Memory Alpha: an automated weapon, with no crew.
